input.summary: The gate's single verified finding was a claim-consistency defect: dependent claim 19 negated the parent step of claim 18 (with the spacer plate interposed, the downwardly projecting portion is no longer pressed against the straight edge), and the claim wording departed from the detailed description, which already states the relationship correctly ("The downwardly projecting portion 32 of the fence 30, or the outer face of the spacer plate 40 when the spacer plate 40 is fitted, is pressed against the selected workpiece edge 92"). I applied exactly the repair the report specifies: claim 18's placing/pressing step now recites pressing the fence against the straight edge with the downwardly projecting portion bearing either against the straight edge or against an interposed spacer plate, and claim 19's opening phrase now tracks that wording, so claim 19 further limits rather than contradicts its parent. Both alternatives were already affirmatively disclosed in input/disclosure.md ("presses the fence or the installed spacer plate against the selected workpiece edge"), so the invention is unchanged and no source-fidelity issue arises. No other file needed a change: the numeral table, drawing descriptions, detailed description, remaining claims, and the seven figure briefs are unaffected by this wording repair and stay byte for byte as approved. No drawing geometry was implicated by the finding, so no figure brief was touched and no rendered artifact was edited.
changes: draft/09-claims.md, claim 18: the placing step now reads "pressing the fence against the straight edge, the downwardly projecting portion of the fence bearing against the straight edge or against a spacer plate fitted between the downwardly projecting portion and the straight edge", so the step covers both disclosed alternatives.

draft/09-claims.md, claim 19: opening phrase changed to "wherein pressing the fence against the straight edge comprises" so the dependent claim narrows the parent step instead of negating it; the remainder of claim 19 is unchanged.

No change to draft/08-detailed-description.md, draft/numerals.md, draft/07-drawings.md, any other claim, or any figure brief - the detailed description already recited the relationship correctly and governs.

I will rewrite the descriptions of the centerline and the workpiece to be more explicit about how they should be rendered, ensuring the centerline is interrupted by the rail and that no boundary is drawn for the fragmentary workpiece.
